kill_gate.status: PRE-DATA -- written 2026-08-14 before any B05 cell ran (0 cells exist)
kill_gate.statement: B05 dies as a standalone paper if, on the 4 retrieval-CLOSED RULER cells (niah_multikey_1 x {16k,32k}, variable_tracking x {16k,32k}) at Qwen3-8B, FEWER THAN 3 of the phases {I joint-readability, II handoff-band, III joint-failure} are non-empty over the rungs j in {6,9,12,18}; OR if the Phase I/II boundary rung differs by >= 2 ladder rungs between niah_multikey_1 and variable_tracking. j=0 is EXCLUDED as degenerate (at resume_j=0 teacher==student per A02 GATE 0; A02 arm A1 vs A0 = 0 correctness flips out of 400 paired items).
kill_gate.threshold: FLOOR = 4.0 pp absolute paired delta per cell AND paired-bootstrap CI95 excluding 0 (n_boot=5000, seed=42). Both conditions, not either. CHOSEN FROM THE COMPARATOR'S OWN MEASURED RESOLUTION, not invented: on these same 4 cells at n=100 A02 called -4.0 pp [-8,-1] SIGNIFICANT and -3.0 pp [-7,0] NOT significant, so the demonstrated detection boundary lies between 3 and 4 pp. Phase separation threshold: >= 3 of 3 phases non-empty; cross-task boundary agreement within 1 ladder rung.
kill_gate.comparator: Anchor A0 = ruler_results/a02_dvr_ruler_j0_top12 (j=0, no adapter, RULER mean 99.75). Per-rung LoRA comparators, all on disk (zwfy6): A2=a02_rtax_ruler_A2_j6 (99.25), A3=a02_rtax_ruler_A3_j9 (98.25), A4=a02_ruler_c2_j12_readlora (90.75), A5=a02_rtax_ruler_A5_j18 (20.75). New B05 arms: N6/N9/N12/N18 = --resume_j {6,9,12,18} with NO --lora_adapter. Comparison is arm-vs-named-arm on paired items, not 'better than baseline'.
kill_gate.what_result_stops_the_work: If N6 comes back at roughly 78/85/61/58 (mean ~70.5) then EVERY rung j in {6,9,12,18} has native readout below A0 by >= 4.0 pp with CI95 excluding 0. Phase I is then EMPTY on the ladder, only Phases II and III are populated, 2 < 3, and the kill gate FIRES: the read tax is a two-regime cliff, which Paper A already reports, and B05 has no third phase to name. Independent second failure route: N6 = 96/97/62/59 puts the I/II boundary at j=9 for niah_multikey_1 but j<6 for variable_tracking, a >= 2-rung gap, firing the cross-task clause even though 3 phases exist pooled. Both outcomes are plausible on the on-disk numbers -- see honest_power_disclosure.
kill_gate.denominator_guard: PRIMARY QUANTITIES ARE ABSOLUTE PAIRED pp. NO HEADLINE NUMBER IS A RATIO. Anchor A0 = 100.0 on 3 of the 4 retrieval-closed cells (Wilson lo 96.3) and 99.0 on the fourth, so any recovery fraction R_j = (LoRA_j - native_j)/(A0 - native_j) has a denominator that can be 0 or negative. R_j is computed ONLY IF (A0 - native_j) >= 10.0 pp AND that denominator's paired-bootstrap CI95 lower bound > 0; otherwise the analyzer MUST emit {"recovery_fraction": null, "reason": "denominator <= 10.0pp or CI95_lo <= 0 -> Delta ill-defined"} and the phase assignment falls back to the absolute-pp rule. This bites at j=6 where native may sit at the ceiling and the denominator -> 0. CEILING CENSORING is declared pre-data: an arm at 100.0 against an anchor at 100.0 has an unmeasurable positive Delta; such cells may support 'indistinguishable' but may NEVER support 'better than'. Per memory/a-range-is-not-a-measurement-until-it-clears-its-floor.
kill_gate.honest_power_disclosure: Phase III is ALREADY non-empty and cannot fail (A02 A5 j=18 = 20.75 vs anchor 99.75, -79.0 pp): that clause carries no discriminating power and is not pretended to. Phase II is very likely non-empty given the motivation merge (native j=9 = 34.25 vs LoRA j=9 = 98.25). ALL the gate's power sits in Phase I, i.e. whether ANY rung j >= 6 still has an intact native readout, and the evidence genuinely does not settle it: QCMEM_J_DETERMINATION.md brackets the 8B zero-shot cliff at j9=100/j10=81/j12=9 on niah_single 16k (suggesting native survives j=6), but the merge of ruler_results/qcmem_8b_zeroshot_j9_chatFALSE on the HARDER retrieval-closed cells gives only 44/59/18/16 -- so the cliff on THESE cells is already shallower than j=9, and whether it is shallower than j=6 is UNMEASURED. That is the coin flip the 16 cells resolve.
kill_gate.what_it_does_NOT_mean: Firing is NOT 'the direction was wrong'. B05's pre-existing exit clause executes: fold into a Paper A/B mechanism subsection. 'readout capacity and split depth are not separable into named phases at this resolution' is itself a reportable negative for Paper A.
